title: Passive activity losses — Gavin Reyes
instructions: Gavin Reyes (MAGI **$120,000**, single) has the activities below for 2025. He isn't a real estate professional.

exhibits.title: Activities
exhibits.content:
- Rental house he manages himself (active participation): loss **$20,000**
- Limited partnership interest (no participation): income **$4,000**
- Software business where he works 600 hours: income **$60,000**

rows.label: Net passive loss before the special allowance
rows.explanation: Passive items net: 20,000 loss − 4,000 LP income = **16,000**.

rows.label: Maximum rental real estate special allowance
Passive loss deductible against nonpassive income
rows.explanation: Lesser of the 16,000 net loss or the 15,000 allowance = **15,000**.

rows.label: Rental house
rows.explanation: Rentals are passive unless he's a real estate professional; active participation only unlocks the allowance.

rows.label: Limited partnership interest
rows.explanation: Limited partners generally don't materially participate.
